description: Voxaura windows — least-privilege surface. Permissions are enumerated from the exact @tauri-apps/api calls the shell makes (WebviewWindow.getByLabel → window:get_all_windows; new WebviewWindow → webview:create_webview_window; setFocus → window:set_focus; window.close → window:close). No filesystem, shell, http, or process plugin is exposed to the webview.
